models.name: Hunyuan 3D 2.1
models.shortDescription: Hunyuan 3D 2.1 by Tencent converts a single image into a textured 3D mesh with production-ready PBR materials, precise geometry, and adjustable face count.

models.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects 2
models.shortDescription: ElevenLabs Sound Effects 2 by ElevenLabs generates custom SFX from text descriptions, with clips up to 30 seconds, seamless looping, and adjustable guidance.

models.name: Photoroom Background Removal
models.shortDescription: Photoroom Background Removal by Photoroom. Clean, precise subject cutouts from any photo, with optional shadow effects and HD mode for high-resolution images.

models.name: Seedance 1 (Pro Fast)
models.shortDescription: Seedance 1 (Pro Fast) by ByteDance generates 1080p cinematic video from text or a first-frame image, at 3x the speed of the standard Pro model.

models.name: Meshy 7.1 - Text-to-3D
models.shortDescription: Generate a fully textured 3D model from a text prompt alone. New geometry resolution tiers (standard, 2K, 4K) add finer surface detail than Meshy 7, with 2K-8K PBR texturing.

models.name: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
models.shortDescription: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 Flare: fast, high-quality text-to-image generation and editing for everyday content, from social posts to product shots and quick creative concepts.

models.name: Neo3D Realism
models.shortDescription: A Flux.1 LoRA for 3D-style renders. Generates detailed figurines, props, game collectibles, and sculptures with realistic textures and lighting.

models.name: ElevenLabs 3
models.shortDescription: ElevenLabs 3 (Alpha) is an expressive text-to-speech model for 70+ languages, using inline tags like [whispers] or [excited] to steer emotion, emphasis, and delivery.
